date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification:
R2-EA-012-R1: Only VTL route eligibility; other approved Safe Travel Lanes may exist. December 20 is announced effective permission, not first observed traveller.

The March 2020 initial visitor prohibition and November 2021 VTL eligibility window are distinct phases. The first policy’s complete exception and amendment chain is not reconstructed; no continuous 2020–2022 duration is inferred.

The March 24, 2022 trade ministry announcement broadens land entry from March 31 at 23:59 for fully vaccinated travellers and children aged 12 or below. ICA reports more than 11,000 travellers cleared at Woodlands and Tuas by 07:00 on April 1. The total is not broken down by immigration category or direction. Travel-document requirements and specified work-pass approvals remained; this is scoped easing, not removal of every entry condition.
